_comment: The Windows developer field run's steps, run by diagnostics/engine/field_run/field_run.ahk under the shared protocol (_shared/diagnostics/data/field_run_protocol.json) when tools/dev/collect-windows-field-report.ps1 asks a developer driver started from this clone. Each field_check step is a Debug tray check run without its window, and the reload step reloads the driver and resumes the run in its successor: no person is needed. A request names its own deadline within deadline_seconds; the default covers every step at its own deadline.

steps.proves: The boot that started this driver completed within [budgets] boot_total_ms, and its duration is named.
The managed download chain works: system proxy kinds, PAC download and verdict, route lookup, TLS trust and one transfer.
The layout composer installs, enables and removes its check layout through the real path.
The driver reloads on request through its reload owner and the successor's field run resumes at the next step; the reload's duration, the successor's launch to its boot completion, is named.
